bio.text: Angus Purdy is an independent candidate for Tennessee's 6th Congressional District in 2026.
In a Nashville Banner candidate questionnaire Purdy lists front-of-house lead at Little Hat's Italian Market as an occupation and a B.A. in history from Vanderbilt University.
In that questionnaire Purdy says a run for Metro Council came in 2023, that Nashville is home, and that a childhood was spent on a small farm in Spring Hill.

sources.title: Angus Purdy: Independent Candidate for Congress, District 6
